objectives.description: Branch Step 2.5.3 on match source; rewrite table rows in place via line-index-targeted apply; fix dry-run over-report; source-aware stderr messages

deviations.description: Re-running --annotate on an already-annotated table row yields annotations_made: 0
deviations.reason: The Step 2.5.2 matcher already filters out rows whose status text contains "*(Completed:" before they ever reach the annotate loop (identical to the pre-existing checkbox path's own matcher-level filter via item.get('completed')). So the second run's high-confidence match list is empty rather than containing one match that the annotator skips with reason 'already_annotated'. Net effect (0 annotations, no duplicate marker, idempotent) is identical to the plan's intent; only which layer performs the filtering differs, and it differs identically to how the unmodified checkbox path already behaves.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — matcher-level filtering makes the annotator's already_annotated skip path a defensive backstop, mirroring the pre-existing checkbox path's own dead-path symmetry)*
